en.answer: Yes, it can. The discarded "Rank-Up-Magic" Normal Spell Card is banished instead of being sent to the Graveyard, but the Xyz Summon is performed normally.
en.question: While the effect of <<6682>> is applying, can <<11932>> be Xyz Summoned by discarding a "Rank-Up-Magic" Normal Spell Card and using a "Utopia" monster as the Xyz Material?
